title: geraniospermum × sanguineum
intro: Geraniospermum × sanguineum, commonly known as Sanguisorba, is a plant species in the rose family that is used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Geraniospermum × sanguineum include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, astringent, and vulnerary, which helps to protect and heal wounds. The bioactive constituents of Geraniospermum × sanguineum include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
